select * from room_type
and type_name like CONCAT('%', #{typeName}, '%')
and status = #{status}

SELECT t.id as id, t.type_name as typeName, t.price as price, t.area as area, t.bed_type as bedType, t.max_guests as maxGuests, t.description as description, i.image_url as mainImage FROM room_type t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_type_id, image_url FROM ( SELECT room_type_id, image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY room_type_id ORDER BY is_main DESC, id ASC) AS rn FROM room_type_image ) ranked_images WHERE rn = 1 ) i ON t.id = i.room_type_id WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.weight DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, type_name FROM room_type WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
